name: p2-2028-round-shapes
title: Three rooms, one skill: the round has two shapes
spec: Three columns, one per room, each a tall card with a header, a 'What the source says' line, and a 'What to prepare' list. Column 1 header 'Final hour with a team leader': source 'Team, projects, services, possibly extra technical questions told in advance' (official); prepare 'A two-minute project story, questions for the team leader, the first-90-days answer'. Column 2 header 'Project deep dive of up to 90 minutes': source 'A technical defence of one significant project' (one secondary source, unverified); prepare 'The full dossier, five levels of why, and a whiteboard sketch'. Column 3 header 'Hiring-manager conversation': source 'Past projects, reasons for key decisions, teamwork' (same secondary source, unverified); prepare 'Decision stories with alternatives, and one teamwork story'. Above the three columns a single line 'The same question arrives in three rooms, and the skill underneath is the same'. A tag on each column marking the evidence: [official] on column 1 and [unverified] on columns 2 and 3. Orange outline on column 2 as the deep dive that punishes breadth. Bottom note: 'Would they trust you with a pager and a production fleet?'
anchor: ### 1. The round has two shapes and one skill
alt: Three interview rooms, a final hour with a team leader, a project deep dive and a hiring-manager conversation, each with a different source and preparation.
cap: The project round appears in three rooms, a final hour, a deep dive and a hiring-manager conversation, and each needs different preparation.

name: p2-2028-project-gate
title: Pick one project with five honest yeses out of six tests
spec: A flow with a start box 'List 3 candidate projects' at the top, then 'Score 6 tests, yes or no for each' as a box with six small test chips listed beside it: 'Made or shaped the key decisions', 'Ran in production', and four more tests drawn as grey chips. A decision diamond 'Five or more yes?'. No branch to 'Drop it, or keep as a second story'. Yes branch to 'Fill the dossier' then a second diamond 'Checker clean?' with a no loop back to 'Fill the dossier' and a yes branch to 'Rehearse at 2 minutes, 10 minutes and 90 minutes'. Side card 'Choose the project where you know the numbers and the mistakes, not the one that sounds biggest.' Orange outline on the 'Five or more yes?' diamond. Caption: 'Breadth is punished in a deep dive: prepare one project deeply.'
alt: A flow for picking one project by scoring six tests, keeping it only with at least five honest yeses, then filling the dossier and rehearsing.
cap: Pick one project by scoring six tests and keeping it only with at least five honest yeses, then fill the dossier and rehearse it.
